name: Grilled yard chicken
summary: Yard chicken rubbed with pounded lá ech and grilled over the coals until the skin turns golden without drying out.
origin: Bao Dak Lak on 29 Aug 2016 describes Êđê and M’nông grilled chicken as one part of the jar-wine, bamboo-rice, and chicken set.
howToEat: Dip it in salt pounded with lá ech, lá giang, culantro, scallion, and green chili, and eat it with bamboo rice. When the salt bites, drink from the jar.
where: Ko Tam community tourism area in Buon Ma Thuot, and Buon Tri A in Buon Don beside the Serepok.
seoTitle: Ga nuong in Buon Ma Thuot — yard chicken and forest salt
seoDescription: Yard chicken rubbed with la ech and grilled golden, with a forest-salt dip and bamboo rice at Ko Tam and Buon Tri A.
